Warm.name: Icy Stark Blue
Warm.reason: Cold blue tones clash with golden skin pigments, creating a sallow or drained look.

Warm.name: Stark Optic White
Warm.reason: Pure white can make warm skin appear overly yellow or washed out; opt for warm cream/ivory.

Warm.name: Cool Magenta / Fuchsia
Warm.reason: Blue-dominant bright magentas overwhelm warm complexions.

Cool.name: Mustard Yellow / Ocher
Cool.reason: Heavy yellow-browns accentuate redness or make cool undertones appear dull.

Cool.name: Warm Orange / Rust
Cool.reason: Warm oranges fight with pink/blue skin undertones, causing a muddy complexion effect.

Neutral.name: Extreme Neon Yellow
